scope: Four initial H-frozen focused QEMU sources, plus read-only transitive lifecycle/collector/registry/gate source checks
reviewer_participation: Reviewer authored service diagnostic registry and some earlier reused lifecycle verifier code. This is method cross-review, not an independently implemented auditor.

findings.problem: Committed jobs/sessions retain creation order, while service pages deterministically sort by UUID; direct zip can reject correct exports or bind wrong raw identities.
findings.change: Sort expected raw jobs/sessions by id and audit by sequence; retain exact typed-row and injective-alias checks.

findings.problem: Selected gate receipt is internally consistent but candidate PID/starttime is not cross-bound to saved actual broker proc identity/ELF and ready/armed records.
findings.change: Use existing saved proc snapshots before/after plus start; compare exact PID/starttime and frozen ELF, ready/armed/candidate relation and nonce/operation only on records actually containing them. No new C fields or gate timing.

findings.problem: Both guests can exit after final loop log read; all-exited break precedes missing-PASS check. Postwait scans only kernel logs, and reused lifecycle subfunctions omit old top-level final PASS/artifact-error gate. Late FAIL or unused artifact encoding error could be missed.
findings.change: After actual waits require exactly one final diagnostic PASS per role and reject all diagnostic FAIL/artifact error/oversize/poweroff-returned markers before assigning PASS.
